title.value: How well does GPT-4o understand vision? Solving standard computer vision tasks with multimodal foundation models

TLDR.value: We develop prompt chaining techniques for multimodal foundation models, e.g. GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Qwen2-VL, etc. to solve standard computer vision tasks such as semantic segmentation and depth estimation.

primary_area.value: foundation or frontier models, including LLMs
